entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A broken world split into five shards, each a separate world defined by the mana it has and lacks.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara cut off from green and white mana, a hellish world ruled by undeath and tormented by demons.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara that includes black, home to constructively ambitious figures.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara that includes black, home to constructively ambitious figures.

entities.name: Vithian humans
entities.description: Surviving humans of Grixis, often aligned with its blue or red aspects rather than black.

entities.name: Necromancer barons
entities.description: The powerful rulers of Grixis, who display ambition and craving for power.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A Ravnica guild of plant-infested zombies, elvish death shamans, undead wurms and trolls, and gorgon triads.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose society is divided into guilds.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane where planeswalker cards debuted.

events.summary: Alara is conceived as five separate worlds (shards), each defined by what mana it lacks as much as by the mana that flows in it.
events.quote: We were able to split the setting up into five entire worlds (not ten, ouch!)

events.summary: Grixis, cut off from green and white mana, becomes a hellish world ruled by undeath and tormented by demons.
events.quote: it naturally gave rise to a hellish world ruled by undeath and tormented by demons

relations.note: Surviving Vithian humans live on Grixis.
relations.quote: even the surviving Vithian humans are often aligned with Grixis's blue or red aspects rather than black

relations.note: The necromancer barons and demon lords display Grixis's power-driven characteristics.
relations.quote: The necromancer barons and demon lords of the plane certainly display all of these characteristics, in a way.
